From _Rockall_ by The House Band

Liner notes attribute it to Rose Murphy of Yorkshire, via Jon Scaife and Roger Wilson. It seems unrelated to the Em tune by the same name. The House Band plays it at a blistering tempo!

↳ Posted by frkrygow on December 29th, 2011.

Rose Murphy

https://thesession.org/recordings/2786
Rose Murphy certainly lived - and was recorded at the age of 76 - in Yorkshire, but she came from Bellmount, near Milltown, Co. Galway, according to the cassette sleeve notes. She was more probably the “House Band’s” source of the tune, rather than it’s composer, as although the sleeve notes say that 2 of her compositions are included on the recording, this is not one of them.

↳ Posted by NfldWhistler on January 26th, 2020.

Re: Father Tom’s Wager

Just to add a step to frkrygow’s comment about the route travelled by Rose Murphy’s version of The Frog in the Well, Pete Coe shared it with me when we played for some ceilidhs years ago. Pete credited it to Rose and drew my attention to her tendency sometimes to play a C# in the 2nd and 6th bars of the B-part, and sometimes a more conventional or convergent C. Roger Wilson and I adopted the C# version.
Jon S.
